realestate.description: Sri Balaji Homes sells 2BHK and 3BHK apartments in Chennai (Porur, Tambaram). Prices 55L to 1.2Cr. We arrange site visits and help with home loans.
realestate.rubric:
- Hot: Wants a site visit, asks about booking amount or loan approval, ready to buy
- Warm: Asking about location, price, sizes, amenities
- Cold: Just greetings or no reply

dental.description: SmileCare Dental Clinic in Coimbatore. Root canal, braces, implants, cleaning. Consultation 300 rupees. Open 9am to 8pm.
dental.rubric:
- Hot: Wants to book an appointment
- Warm: Asking about treatments or cost
- Cold: Not interested

coaching.description: Vetri NEET Academy, Madurai. One-year NEET repeater batch and crash course. Fees 85,000 per year, EMI available. Hostel for girls and boys.
coaching.rubric:
- Hot: Parent or student ready to join or pay fees
- Warm: Asking about fees, batch timing, results, hostel
- Cold: Greetings, wrong number, unrelated
